description: Sample script testing the Complex class by creating instances and performing arithmetic operations (add, subtract, multiply, divide, divideInto) with various inputs.

classes.name: Complex
classes.description: A class representing complex numbers with methods for arithmetic operations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for creating a Complex number from a number, string, or array.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a value or another Complex object to this complex number.

methods.name: subtract
methods.description: Subtracts a value or another Complex object from this complex number.

methods.name: multiply
methods.description: Multiplies this complex number by a scalar or another Complex object.

methods.name: divideBy
methods.description: Divides this complex number by a scalar or another Complex object.

methods.name: divideInto
methods.description: Divides this complex number into another number or complex object (inverse division).
